sentences.en: Powerful bombs won't get destroyed as long as capitalism continues.
sentences.zh: 只要资本主义继续存在，强大的炸弹也不会被摧毁。

sentences.en: Winston hated capitalism, because he could never afford a house.
sentences.zh: 温斯顿憎恨资本主义，因为他永远买不起房子。

sentences.en: You guys can't envision the final collapse of capitalism? Incredible!
sentences.zh: 你们竟然无法想象资本主义最终崩溃？真是难以置信！

senses.zh: 资本主义(制度) - 资本(或财富)的拥有 - 资本(私人占有和生产盈利)的支配地位
